items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Duke Ellington only in response to the interviewer's prompts about composition style and band longevity, without stating any personal interaction or professional relationship.

ctx.x: Yeah. In fact, that whole way of composing is still alive today. Duke Ellington always did the same thing, you know. Cootie would add something in, or Rex Stewart.
